subject: Re: sensing API: agreed; calibration from the playbook windows
body: Agreed on start(profile, onEvent, opts), the 1 Hz frames plus 5 s features, manual() and connectStrap() behind a click. The Calibrate screen shows the peak window (playbook 1.2 to 1.5) and the contrast window (3.1 to 3.2) as two bands, so please expose both. Demo timing to pin demo.json against: Live starts about 1:45 and the drift should open the gate at about 20 s into Live. I'll show false fires per minute on Live.
